target.title: [codex] Add Doubao coding plan usage
target.body:
## Summary

Fixes #1724.

This adds first-class Doubao Coding Plan usage fetching through Volcengine's signed OpenAPI path while preserving the existing Ark API-key probe as a fallback.

## What changed

- Add Volcengine AK/SK/region settings and environment projection for Doubao.
- Add HMAC-SHA256 Volcengine request signing for `GetCodingPlanUsage`.
- Parse `QuotaUsage` into 5-hour, weekly, and monthly usage windows.
- Keep the legacy Ark bearer-token probe when only an Ark API key is configured.
- Surface Volcengine `ResponseMetadata.Error.{Code,Message}` on failures, so a key lacking the `ark:GetCodingPlanUsage` permission shows `AccessDenied: …` instead of an opaque `HTTP 403 (322 bytes)`.

## Investigation notes

`opencli` inspection of the Volcengine Ark console showed the Coding Plan page calling `GetCodingPlanUsage`, returning `session`, `weekly`, and `monthly` percentages plus reset timestamps. The signing implementation follows Volcengine's documented HMAC-SHA256 request shape with the `date/region/service/request` credential scope.

## Live proof (after-fix, CodexBar's own signed path)

Ran CodexBar's own signed CLI with a long-term Volcengine AK/SK (via `CODEXBAR_CONFIG`, no `ark-cli` involved). `DoubaoUsageFetcher` signs the request, calls `GetCodingPlanUsage`, and renders the three windows — "Limits not available" is gone:

```
== Doubao (api) ==
5-hour:  99% left   Resets in 2h 38m
Weekly:  97% left   Resets in 3d 7h
Monthly: 99% left   Resets in 23d 7h
Plan: Running
```

Independently cross-checked with the official `@volcengine/ark-cli` (`arkcli usage plan --product coding-plan`) — matches 1:1 (session 0.0023% used → 99% left, weekly 2.49% → 97%, monthly 1.26% → 99%). Details: https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/1727#issuecomment-4863675403

While validating, an under-permissioned key returned Volcengine `AccessDenied` on `ark:GetCodingPlanUsage` (not `SignatureDoesNotMatch`), confirming the signer itself is correct — the request authenticates and is authorized server-side. That also motivated the error-surfacing change above.

Note (scope): the signer uses long-term AK/SK only — it does not attach an STS `X-Security-Token`, so SSO/temporary credentials won't work. Happy to add session-token support as a follow-up if wanted.

## Validation

- `make check`
- `swift test --filter 'Doubao|ProviderConfigEnvironment|ConfigValidation'` — green (incl. new `coding plan fetch surfaces volcengine access denied error`)
- `swift run CodexBarCLI usage --provider doubao --source api` — renders real Coding Plan windows with a permissioned AK/SK; falls back to the Ark bearer probe when only an Ark API key is present
- Rebased onto latest `main`; branch is `MERGEABLE` and CI is green.

## Remaining gate

Product decision (issue is labeled `needs-product-decision`): whether to accept a Volcengine AK/SK credential path for Doubao. The implementation keeps a single settings field and auto-selects signed vs. bearer by input shape (`AKLT…` access key → signed), so it doesn't force a second credential UI or regress bearer-only users.
